what: The title is split into letters, and when it enters the area excluding 10% at the top and bottom of the screen, each letter in turn at .06s pops up — transparent, 50% of its height below, flattened to 1.2 wide and .8 tall — rises 10% above at 40%, flattens again 5% below at 70%, then settles in place (.6s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1)). Each line can take its own delay, and the sub heading (sub) rises from 150% below in .6s. With split: none the whole element pops (speech bubble·character image)

options.stagger: Delay between letters (s), default .06 — the first letter also starts one step (.06) late (original calc(.06 * n))
options.gap: Line (data-fx-part="line") delay added per step (seconds), default 0 — if a row has data-delay, that value
options.dur: Time for one letter to pop (sec), default .6
options.on: enter (default, when on screen) · load (when window load finishes — subpage hero title) · state (when the caller adds is-in)
options.split: With none, the element is not split and pops as a whole
options.look: small: Subtler type — flattened below 30% · 1.1/.9 (original bound-small, art and speech bubbles)

from.where: index.html section headings (BBQ·STAY·ACCESS·NEWS·SNS)·card titles — original .js_lettering letter spans + .js_inview._inview with bound .6s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1) calc(.06*n), IntersectionObserver rootMargin -10% 0px. The first intro heading runs 0·.3·.5s per line (.03s per letter), the subpage first heading starts after load (js_loaded_heading), and the character art uses bound-small .3s later
from.options: stagger · gap · on: load · split: none; look: small
